chunks: Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
The obligatory tawaf, if you add to it, is like the obligatory salat (prayer): if you add to it, then repetition is required of you; and likewise the sa'y.

key_terms.السَّعْيُ: the ritual walking between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the obligatory salat (prayer) used here as a legal comparison
key_terms.الطَّوَافُ: the ritual circumambulation around the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition of the act due to invalidating addition
key_terms.الْمَفْرُوضُ: that which is obligatory and prescribed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone adds extra rounds to the obligatory tawaf or sa'y?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning excess addition in obligatory tawaf and sa'y. It states that adding beyond the prescribed amount in obligatory tawaf is treated like adding to an obligatory salat (prayer), requiring repetition, and that the same rule applies to sa'y.
